propositions: Running review-plan on a non-claimable ticket wastes a billable LLM call producing an unusable attestation.
review-plan should fast-fail before context assembly or any LLM pass when the ticket is not claimable, returning an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict.
An open ticket blocked by an unclosed depends_on/blocks prerequisite returns INDETERMINATE with coverage.llm_ran=false, a ticket-not-claimable finding, signs no attestation, and exits 2.
closed/idea/blocked tickets fast-fail identically while in_progress tickets are never fast-failed even with an open blocker.
--force / force=True bypasses the fast-fail and runs the full review.
bug/session_log tickets remain gate-exempt and the fast-fail performs no LLM or network call.
